competency.practice_task: Produce a stepwise derivation with units or invariants grounded in a model-data-run provenance chain.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a seeded simulation with an explicit environment version.
required_evidence: a stepwise derivation with units or invariants
Include the simulator config, seed band and baseline run.
Report complete traceability to hashes and versions with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: missing a training-data or adapter version.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of lineage auditing.
Practice: the derivation reproduces a checked special case.
Measurement: report complete traceability to hashes and versions against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for missing a training-data or adapter version; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
